-- ¡LOTERIA: GAME ON!
INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = '¡LOTERIA: GAME ON!' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2023', 'Latinx Theatre', 'Family Show', 'Contemporary', 'Cultural');

-- Boeing, Boeing
INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Boeing, Boeing' AND t.name IN ('Comedy', '2023', 'Farce', '1960s', 'French Comedy', 'College Theatre');

-- The Merry Wives of Windsor
INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'The Merry Wives of Windsor' AND t.name IN ('Shakespeare', '2022', 'Comedy', 'College Theatre', 'Elizabethan', 'Farce');
